columns.name: MINIMUM_LINE_COUNT
columns.description: Minimum number of standalone sales required in order to calculate a valid VSOE price.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_PCT_RANGE_HIGH
columns.description: Higher limit of the VSOE fair price tolerance range in percentage.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_PCT_RANGE_LOW
columns.description: Lower limit of the VSOE fair price tolerance range in percentage.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_RANGE_COVERAGE
columns.description: The required minimum percentage of standalone sales that its unit selling price falls within tolerance range price of an item.

columns.name: USE_TOLERANCE_FOR_COMPLIANCE
columns.description: A flag that indicates if a tolerance range should be used during compliance validation process of a MEA line or not.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates if the pricing combination is active.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SUMMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Internal use only. Summary flag is required in the pricing dimension combination assignment process.
